_comment: Offline knowledge base of version-based weaknesses. Matches are version-string based and therefore UNVERIFIED: vendors and distributions frequently backport fixes without changing the upstream version string. Extend this file or supply DFA_COMPONENT_KB to add entries.

entries.title: OpenSSL version affected by Heartbleed (CVE-2014-0160)
entries.description: OpenSSL 1.0.1 through 1.0.1f contain the Heartbleed TLS heartbeat over-read that leaks process memory, including private keys.

entries.title: End-of-life OpenSSL branch (1.1.0 or older)
entries.description: OpenSSL 1.1.0 and older branches no longer receive public security fixes (1.0.2 ended 2019-12-31, 1.1.0 ended 2019-09-11).

entries.title: End-of-life OpenSSL 1.1.1
entries.description: OpenSSL 1.1.1 reached end of life on 2023-09-11 and no longer receives public security fixes.

entries.title: OpenSSH version in range affected by regreSSHion (CVE-2024-6387)
entries.description: OpenSSH 8.5p1 up to (not including) 9.8p1 on glibc-based Linux contains a signal-handler race in sshd that can lead to unauthenticated remote code execution.

entries.title: BusyBox older than 1.34.0 (multiple CVEs incl. awk/ash/hush memory corruption)
entries.description: BusyBox releases before 1.34.0 are affected by the CVE-2021-42373..CVE-2021-42386 series (use-after-free and out-of-bounds issues in awk, ash, hush, man, lzma, etc.).

entries.title: BusyBox before 1.35 affected by ash stack overflow (CVE-2022-48174)
entries.description: CVE-2022-48174 describes a stack overflow in BusyBox ash before 1.35 that may allow code execution via crafted shell input.

entries.title: dnsmasq older than 2.83 (DNSpooq)
entries.description: dnsmasq before 2.83 is affected by the DNSpooq cache-poisoning and buffer overflow vulnerabilities.

entries.title: Dropbear SSH older than 2022.82 (CVE-2021-36369)
entries.description: Dropbear before 2022.82 permits 'trivial authentication', which can let a malicious server complete authentication with a forwarded agent without user approval.

entries.title: zlib older than 1.2.12 (CVE-2018-25032)
entries.description: zlib before 1.2.12 can corrupt memory when compressing input with many distant matches.

entries.title: glibc version in range affected by Looney Tunables (CVE-2023-4911)
entries.description: glibc 2.34-2.38 contain a buffer overflow in the dynamic loader's GLIBC_TUNABLES handling allowing local privilege escalation. Most distributions backported the fix; verify the patch level.

entries.title: hostapd older than 2.7 (KRACK key reinstallation attacks)
entries.description: hostapd/wpa_supplicant before 2.7 without vendor patches are affected by KRACK (CVE-2017-13077 and related).

entries.title: wpa_supplicant older than 2.7 (KRACK key reinstallation attacks)
entries.description: wpa_supplicant before 2.7 without vendor patches is affected by KRACK (CVE-2017-13077 and related).

entries.title: Linux kernel branch older than 5.10 (upstream LTS support ended)
entries.description: Upstream kernel.org long-term support for branches older than 5.10 has ended as of the knowledge-base date. Some vendors (e.g. CIP SLTS) still maintain older branches; verify the vendor patch level.

entries.title: Mbed TLS branch older than 3.6 LTS
entries.description: Mbed TLS 2.28 LTS reached end of life at the end of 2024 and non-LTS 3.x releases before 3.6 are unsupported.
